title: Thinking on Serendipity & Making Life Work For You
summary: Kahran and Divya start from the premise that life always finds a way and explore whether that's positive psychology, pattern-matching brains, or something else. They detour through nuclear physics (why stable nuclei have a size limit) and into how wanting something without taking action turns 'I want' into 'I wish' — and how a small reframe (admin tasks take two minutes) can unstick years of slow self-defeat.

intents.display: to think about how to make life work out for you
